Qwen3-8B.description: Recommended — roster-verified via unauthenticated GET https://moark.com/v1/models (2026-09-28, HTTP 200, 222 models). Chosen as `default` because Moark's own text-generation guide (https://moark.com/docs/products/apis/texts/text-generation, retrieved 2026-09-28) names Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B specifically as its suggested free-testing/validation models ('免费在线体验', quick-validation picks) — the only concrete, documented model recommendation on that page that also matches a currently-live roster id; the page's other named examples (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct used in every code sample, kimi-k2-instruct and DeepSeek-R1 for long-text/reasoning, ERNIE-4.5-Turbo for multilingual) are not presented as free and, except ERNIE-4.5-Turbo, are no longer on the live roster. No credential-free capability probe was possible (chat/completions is POST-only, and this onboarding used unauthenticated GETs only): tool calling, structured output (guided_json/guided_choice) and SSE streaming are documented generically for the API but not confirmed against this specific model. contextWindow/maxOutputTokens are left unset on every model in this catalog — Moark's docs give only a generic '32K、128K 等' illustration (not tied to any model) and GET /v1/models returns only {id, object, created, owned_by}, no context_length or pricing fields.

instructions: 1. Visit: https://moark.com and sign in — no separate signup page is documented, only workbench login
2. Go to 工作台 → 设置 → 访问令牌 (Workbench → Settings → Access Tokens) at https://moark.com/dashboard/tokens and create a token

3. Fund a prepaid resource package before making live calls (e.g. the all-model package, https://moark.com/serverless-api/order?package=1910) — billing is prepaid, charged per-call or per-token (https://moark.com/docs/products/apis, retrieved 2026-09-28); models can be tried free in the web console, but no formal free-tier API policy is documented, and package usage is non-refundable (https://moark.com/docs/billing/purchase, retrieved 2026-09-28)
setup.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.moark.com/v1 — Moark's own docs state '模力方舟的 Serverless API 兼容开发者喜爱且社区流行的 OpenAI 风格 API' (https://moark.com/docs/products/apis/texts/text-generation, retrieved 2026-09-28), serving 222 models (unauthenticated GET /v1/models, 2026-09-28) spanning text, vision, image, video, audio, embedding and reranking — this entry covers only the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions surface. The vendor also documents vLLM-style guided_json/guided_choice structured-decoding parameters, distinct from the OpenAI response_format field NeuroLink's generic client sends, so structuredOutput is not claimed here without a live probe.
